scope: All bedside physiological outputs, including numerical results, dose suggestions, thresholds, and management guidance. Psychometric calculator fixtures are governed separately.
evidenceLimit: Implementation inventory and engineering drift pins only. Source leads below are unverified implementation attributions, not reviewed primary-source correspondence, clinical validation, or release approval.

algorithms.formula: CrCl=(140-age)*weight*1.23/SCr for male or 1.04 for female (SCr umol/L); (140-age)*weight/(72*SCr)*(0.85 if female) for mg/dL. Devine IBW base 50/45.5 kg + 0.9*(heightCm-152.4); adjusted weight=IBW+0.4*(actual-IBW).
sourceLeads: Cockcroft-Gault and Devine formulas named in implementation; exact primary publications and claim correspondence not recorded.
AMH / Therapeutic Guidelines named in implementation; edition, page and correspondence not recorded.
reviewRequired: Weight selection, rounding and application to renal drug dosing
Renal stages, warnings and lithium management note

algorithms.formula: eGFR=142*min(SCr/kappa,1)^alpha*max(SCr/kappa,1)^-1.2*0.9938^age*(1.012 if female); kappa=0.7/0.9 and alpha=-0.241/-0.302 for female/male; SCr mg/dL, conversion umol/L /88.42.
sourceLeads: 2021 CKD-EPI creatinine equation (race-free) named in implementation; exact primary publication and claim correspondence not recorded.
KDIGO / Australian guidelines named in implementation; edition and correspondence not recorded.

algorithms.formula: RR seconds=60/HR; Bazett QTc=QT/sqrt(RR); Fridericia QTc=QT/cbrt(RR); Framingham QTc=QT+154*(1-RR); Hodges QTc=QT+1.75*(HR-60), QT/QTc milliseconds.
sourceLeads: Bazett, Fridericia, Framingham and Hodges equations named in implementation; primary papers, versions and correspondence not recorded.
reviewRequired: Heart-rate/sex selection, measurement population and invalid-input limits
Risk thresholds, kinetic cautions and medication/cardiology advice

algorithms.formula: Raw dose=current dose*(target level/current level); rounded dose=round(raw dose/increment)*increment. Additional input/ratio/dose bounds are implementation controls, not validated safe prescribing limits.
sourceLeads: Linear kinetics and Australian tablet increments asserted in implementation; dedicated primary source and prescribing validation not recorded.
reviewRequired: Linear kinetics, sampling, steady state and patient exclusions
